# Configuration reference

Every setting MoneyBin reads, one row per value. Set a value as an environment variable with the `MONEYBIN_` prefix, joining nested sections with `__` (`MONEYBIN_MCP__MAX_ROWS`), or put the same lines in `.env.<profile>` under the data home, falling back to `.env`. Precedence is explicit constructor values, then the process environment, then the dotenv file. `MONEYBIN_HOME` itself must come from the environment or `--home`: the dotenv file lives inside the home it would name.

Paths marked `<profile dir>` resolve to `<home>/profiles/<profile>/`.

## Top level

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_DEBUG` | bool | `false` | Enable debug mode |
| `MONEYBIN_ENVIRONMENT` | one of `development`, `staging`, `production` | `development` | Application environment |
| `MONEYBIN_PROFILE` | text | `default` | User profile name (e.g., alice, bob, household) |

## database

Database configuration settings.

`MoneyBinSettings` builds this whole section from the active profile's directory when it is constructed, and a constructor value outranks the environment and the dotenv file, so the variables below are not read today: every profile runs on the defaults shown.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__PATH` | Path | `<profile dir>/moneybin.duckdb` | Path to DuckDB database file |
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__BACKUP_PATH` | Path (optional) | `<profile dir>/backups` | Path to database backup directory |
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__ENCRYPTION_KEY_MODE` | one of `auto`, `passphrase` | `auto` | How the encryption key is managed: auto-generated or user passphrase |
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__TEMP_DIRECTORY` | Path (optional) | `<profile dir>/temp` | DuckDB temp spill directory. Defaults to data/\<profile>/temp/ |
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__ARGON2_TIME_COST` | int (≥ 1) | `3` | Argon2id time cost (iterations) |
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__ARGON2_MEMORY_COST` | int (≥ 8192) | `65536` | Argon2id memory cost in KiB |
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__ARGON2_PARALLELISM` | int (≥ 1) | `4` | Argon2id degree of parallelism |
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__ARGON2_HASH_LEN` | int (≥ 16) | `32` | Argon2id output hash length in bytes |
| `MONEYBIN_DATABASE__NO_AUTO_UPGRADE` | bool | `false` | Skip versioned migrations and SQLMesh migrate on startup. Encryption and schema init still run. |

## mcp

MCP server runtime configuration.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_MCP__MAX_ROWS` | int (≥ 1) | `1000` | Maximum rows returned by any MCP query tool |
| `MONEYBIN_MCP__MAX_CHARS` | int (≥ 1) | `50000` | Deprecated compatibility setting. Accepted but inert. |
| `MONEYBIN_MCP__ALLOWED_TABLES` | list of text (optional) | unset | Deprecated compatibility setting. Accepted but inert; it does not restrict query access. |
| `MONEYBIN_MCP__MAX_ITEMS` | int (≥ 1) | `500` | Maximum length of any list-typed parameter accepted by an MCP tool. Validated at the decorator level for any tool whose signature includes list[X] / Sequence[X] / tuple[X, ...]. Exceeding returns a ResponseEnvelope.error with code='too_many_items'. Parallels max_rows for read responses. See docs/specs/moneybin-mcp.md §Collection size cap. |
| `MONEYBIN_MCP__ELICITATION_WAIT_SECONDS` | float (> 0.0) | `120.0` | How long a destructive-operation confirmation prompt waits for a human before degrading to the opaque-token path. Excluded from tool_timeout_seconds, which bounds machine work only — no DuckDB connection is held across the prompt. |
| `MONEYBIN_MCP__CONFIRMATION_TTL_SECONDS` | int (≥ 30, ≤ 900) | `300` | Lifetime of process-local destructive-mutation confirmation tokens. |
| `MONEYBIN_MCP__TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | float (> 0.0) | `30.0` | Hard wall-clock cap for any single MCP tool dispatch. On timeout, the active DuckDB statement is interrupted and the connection is reset so subsequent calls aren't wedged behind a stale write lock. Must be >= the write-lock wait so a timed-out write tool's worker can never acquire the lock and commit after the caller gave up. |

## matching

Transaction matching and dedup configuration.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_MATCHING__HIGH_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD` | float (≥ 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.95` | Auto-merge score floor. Necessary but not sufficient: a pair must also have agreeing descriptions before it merges without review. |
| `MONEYBIN_MATCHING__REVIEW_THRESHOLD` | float (≥ 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.7` | Dedup review floor. No longer admits or discards a duplicate candidate — every cross-source pair that survives assignment is reviewable, and the within-source tier has no review queue. It still bounds the scoring weights (a window-edge pair scores only _WEIGHT_DESCRIPTION, which must stay at or above this) and is validated against high_confidence_threshold. Transfer review uses transfer_review_threshold, not this. |
| `MONEYBIN_MATCHING__DATE_WINDOW_DAYS` | int (≥ 0) | `5` | Maximum days between transaction dates for candidate pairs |
| `MONEYBIN_MATCHING__SOURCE_PRIORITY` | list of text | `manual`, `gsheet`, `ofx`, `plaid`, `csv`, `excel`, `tsv`, `parquet`, `feather`, `pipe` | Source types in priority order (first = highest priority) |
| `MONEYBIN_MATCHING__TRANSFER_REVIEW_THRESHOLD` | float (≥ 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.55` | Review queue threshold for transfer pairs |
| `MONEYBIN_MATCHING__TRANSFER_SIGNAL_WEIGHTS` | mapping of text to float | `{"date_distance": 0.6, "keyword": 0.4}` | Per-signal weights for transfer confidence scoring |

## doctor

`moneybin system doctor` integrity-check configuration.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_DOCTOR__AUDIT_COVERAGE_LOOKBACK_DAYS` | int (≥ 1) | `7` | Audit-coverage checks only inspect protected app.* rows mutated within this many days. Bounds the cost on large profiles and lets users suppress pre-migration noise by lowering it after rollout. |
| `MONEYBIN_DOCTOR__AUDIT_COVERAGE_SAMPLE_CAP` | int (≥ 1) | `1000` | Maximum rows sampled per table for the audit-coverage check. `moneybin system doctor --full` bypasses the cap and scans every row. |
| `MONEYBIN_DOCTOR__DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT_OVERLAP_RATIO` | float (> 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.5` | duplicate_account_overlap warns when this fraction of one account's transactions have a same-amount counterpart within the matcher's date window on a sibling account at the same institution. Below it, the shared rows read as coincidence. |
| `MONEYBIN_DOCTOR__DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT_MIN_DISTINCT_AMOUNTS` | int (≥ 1) | `10` | Minimum distinct amounts among the mirrored rows before duplicate_account_overlap will judge a pair. Two savings accounts posting the same interest every month mirror each other perfectly on one amount; a duplicated account mirrors many. |

## investments

Holdings valuation configuration (`investments-price-feeds.md`).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_INVESTMENTS__PRICE_STALENESS_DEFAULT_DAYS` | int (≥ 1) | `4` | Age in days beyond which a security's last close is reported stale, for security types `moneybin.staleness.SECURITY_TYPE_STALENESS_DAYS` does not name (`cash`, `other`). Defaults to the exchange-traded value because it absorbs an ordinary weekend; a tighter global default would fire on most days and train the reader to ignore the warning. |
| `MONEYBIN_INVESTMENTS__PRICE_DISAGREEMENT_TOLERANCE_PCT` | float (> 0) | `2.0` | Percent difference between two provider closes for the same security, date, and quote currency beyond which `investment_price_disagreement` reports them. Sized to the failure it actually catches — a feed key bound to the wrong security, which yields order-of-magnitude differences — rather than to the precision two feeds agree to. Legitimate differences exist and must not fire: a broker's crypto valuation is struck at its own snapshot time while CoinGecko's is a 00:00 UTC close, so a volatile day separates them by more than a percent with both correct. |

## categorization

Auto-rule proposal and lifecycle configuration.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD` | int (≥ 1) | `1` | Propose an auto-rule after N matching user categorizations |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_OVERRIDE_THRESHOLD` | int (≥ 1) | `2` | Deactivate an auto-rule after N user overrides of its assignments |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_DEFAULT_PRIORITY` | int (≥ 1) | `200` | Priority assigned to promoted auto-rules (higher number = lower priority) |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_SAMPLE_TXN_CAP` | int (≥ 1) | `5` | Maximum number of sample transaction IDs retained per proposal |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT` | int (≥ 1) | `100` | Default LIMIT applied to auto-rule listing endpoints (categorize auto review, categorize auto rules) when no explicit --limit is given. Caps memory and response size for unbounded queues. |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_MIN_CONTAINS_LENGTH` | int (≥ 1) | `4` | Minimum length for a machine-invented 'contains' pattern. Shorter patterns are proposed as 'exact' instead: a 2-char contains rule (e.g. 'TO', from a truncated 'TRANSFER TO ...') matches STORE, AUTO and TOTAL, so one accepted proposal silently relabels the ledger. |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_BROAD_MATCH_MIN` | int (≥ 1) | `20` | Blast-radius floor. A proposal matching fewer transactions than this is never flagged broad, however thin its evidence — keeps the guard from crying wolf on small rules. |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_BROAD_MATCH_FACTOR` | int (≥ 1) | `10` | A proposal is broad when its estimated match count exceeds factor x trigger_count — i.e. its blast radius is disproportionate to the evidence behind it. Broad proposals cannot be accepted without an explicit allow_broad override. |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__AUTO_RULE_BACKFILL_SCAN_CAP` | int (≥ 1) | `50000` | Maximum number of uncategorized transactions scanned when backfilling a newly-approved auto-rule. Caps memory of the in-Python match loop; transactions beyond the cap remain uncategorized until the next apply_rules run picks them up. |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__ASSIST_OFFER_THRESHOLD` | int (≥ 1) | `10` | Min uncategorized count to surface assist hint in import summary |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__ASSIST_DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE` | int (≥ 1, ≤ 500) | `100` | Default txns per categorize_assist call |
| `MONEYBIN_CATEGORIZATION__ASSIST_MAX_BATCH_SIZE` | int (≥ 1, ≤ 500) | `200` | Hard upper bound enforced server-side |

## import

File-import related settings (inbox layout + confirmation gate).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_IMPORT___PDF_PREVIEW_SIZE_LIMIT_MB` | int (≥ 1) | `100` | Maximum PDF size in MB that import_preview may materialize and persist as an immutable confirmation snapshot. Override with MONEYBIN_IMPORT___PDF_PREVIEW_SIZE_LIMIT_MB. |
| `MONEYBIN_IMPORT___INBOX_ROOT` | Path | `~/Documents/MoneyBin` | Parent directory for the user-facing import workspace. Per-profile subdirs (\<inbox_root>/\<profile>/{inbox,processed,failed}/) are created on first use. Defaults to ~/Documents/MoneyBin. |
| `MONEYBIN_IMPORT___CONFIDENCE__T_HIGH` | float (≥ 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.9` | Score at or above which a detection is banded high. |
| `MONEYBIN_IMPORT___CONFIDENCE__T_MED` | float (≥ 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.7` | Score at or above which a detection is banded medium; below it, low. |
| `MONEYBIN_IMPORT___SELF_ACCEPT_HIGH` | bool | `false` | When True, MCP-driven imports auto-accept a `high`-tier first encounter. Gated off until the calibration corpus proves the `high` band clears the precision bar (smart-import-confirmation.md Req 12). The CLI human path always prompts regardless. |

## gsheet

Configuration for the Google Sheets connector.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_GSHEET__OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` | text | `756678783976-ld203ch19knsc2th5b6sc7mm5tq3dtpd.apps.googleusercontent.com` | OAuth 2.0 client ID for the installed-app Google OAuth flow. Defaults to MoneyBin's public client; override with MONEYBIN_GSHEET__OAUTH_CLIENT_ID to use your own Google Cloud project. Empty disables the connector. |
| `MONEYBIN_GSHEET__OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` | secret (optional) | built in | OAuth 2.0 client secret for the installed-app Google OAuth flow. Google's Desktop clients require it in the code->token exchange even under PKCE; RFC 8252 §8.5 says a secret shipped to every user is not confidential. Defaults to MoneyBin's public client secret; override with MONEYBIN_GSHEET__OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET alongside your own MONEYBIN_GSHEET__OAUTH_CLIENT_ID. Empty disables the connector. |
| `MONEYBIN_GSHEET__API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | float (> 0.0) | `30.0` | HTTP timeout for Google Sheets API + token endpoint calls. |

## providers

Per-provider configuration (OFX, Plaid, tabular).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__OFX__RAW_DATA_PATH` | Path (optional) | unset | Where raw OFX files are staged; the extractor resolves `<profile dir>/ofx` when unset. Read from a config passed to `OFXExtractor`; this setting is not wired to it yet. |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__OFX__PRESERVE_SOURCE_FILES` | bool | `true` | Keep the original source files after extraction. Not read by the extractor yet. |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__OFX__VALIDATE_BALANCES` | bool | `true` | Validate balance fields during extraction. Not read by the extractor yet. |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__TABULAR__TEXT_SIZE_LIMIT_MB` | int | `25` | Maximum file size (MB) for text formats (CSV/TSV) |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__TABULAR__BINARY_SIZE_LIMIT_MB` | int | `100` | Maximum file size (MB) for binary formats (Excel/Parquet/Feather) |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__TABULAR__ROW_WARN_THRESHOLD` | int | `10000` | Row count above which a warning is logged |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__TABULAR__ROW_REFUSE_THRESHOLD` | int | `50000` | Row count above which import is refused (use --no-row-limit to override) |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__TABULAR__BALANCE_PASS_THRESHOLD` | float (≥ 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.9` | Minimum fraction of balance deltas that must match for balance validation to pass |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__TABULAR__BALANCE_TOLERANCE_CENTS` | int (≥ 0) | `1` | Per-delta tolerance in cents for balance validation |
| `MONEYBIN_PROVIDERS__TABULAR__ACCOUNT_MATCH_THRESHOLD` | float (≥ 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.6` | Fuzzy-match similarity threshold (difflib.SequenceMatcher.ratio) for account-name matching. Below this threshold, candidates are treated as 'no match'. |
